screenshots.action: Open the application with clean storage.
screenshots.expected: OB1 presents Begin and Skip intro.
OB2 explains ghost overlay, pose library, and auto-capture.
Demo stage animates and provides coaching feedback.
OB3 offers camera permission and Demo Mode.
OB4 presents four persona goals and disabled completion.
Photographer is highlighted and Start Exploring becomes enabled.
Home appears with personalized greeting.

screenshots.action: Review featured pose and category cards.
screenshots.expected: Home shows featured CTA, categories, and tab navigation.
Search, filters, and 16 category cards are available.
Matching pose cards replace category browsing.
The query is treated as text and an empty state is shown.
Standing list shows pose thumbnails and count.
Detail sheet shows title, instructions, actions, avatar, and skeleton.
The procedural skeleton changes viewpoint.
Favorite control remains visibly selected.

screenshots.action: Start a session from pose detail.
screenshots.expected: Timer defaults Off and four overlay choices are present.
Setup preview accurately represents skeleton.
Setup preview accurately represents ghost.
Setup preview accurately represents off.
Setup preview accurately represents avatar.

screenshots.action: Begin Capture in demo camera mode.
screenshots.expected: Score, simulated-scoring disclosure, shutter, and next preview are visible.
Flow control visibly changes to ON.
Camera overlay state changes without leaving the session.
Review shows captured image, score, filters, retake/share/save actions.
Captured review visibly applies the selected preset.
Gallery opens with the newly captured item.
Capture count and card are visible with management controls.
Save, Copy, Download, Share, Favorite, and Delete are visible.
A duplicated capture becomes the selected detail item.
Gallery ordering reflects score sort.
Cards show per-pose group counts.
Checkboxes and bulk action bar appear.
Selection count becomes one and selected card is outlined.
Session, pose, score, and history areas are visible.
Preferences, editor, marketplace, and tour entry points are visible.
Twenty sliders and avatar/skeleton/ghost previews render.
Live previews and numeric value update.
Prior joint state is restored.
Saved pose appears in the editor list.
Success feedback confirms report storage.
Product grid, search, prices, ratings, and filters appear.
Matching product cards remain visible.
Preview drawer names the first two poses when available.
Creator identity and catalog are shown.
Product becomes owned and its action changes to Open.
Purchased pack appears with Open and Rate controls.
Earnings summary and publish form are visible.

screenshots.action: Create two sections with six poses.
screenshots.expected: Builder shows sections, pose cards, sources, and actions.
A third section appears.
Current pose, section/pose progress, navigation, camera, and photo strip appear.
Pose progress and procedural preview advance.
Section progress moves to Dynamic and pose resets.
Current-section photo strip gains a tagged thumbnail.

screenshots.action: Search for wind within the tour.
screenshots.expected: Matching tour pose is offered as a jump target.
Drawer lists every section and pose count.
Summary groups captured photos by section and shows total.

issues.description: Favorite is visible but the Close button intercepts pointer events at this viewport.
